title: Duplicated Representation (State Synchronization Debt)
damaged_code:
```rust
struct Wheel {
    rim: f64,
    tire: f64,
    diameter: f64, // calculated and stored redundantly
}
```
pattern: Storing raw inputs alongside their calculated derivatives within the fields of the same struct, requiring manual synchronization.
why_bad: Violates the single source of truth. If one field is updated but its derivative is not, the struct enters an invalid, corrupted state.
detection: Fields in a struct that represent simple mathematical or logical calculations derived from other fields in the same struct.
counterexample: Pre-calculating and caching highly expensive computational results to meet strict performance micro-benchmarks.
fix: Remove the redundant derived field and calculate the value dynamically on-demand using a method.
source: Sandi Metz, *Practical Object-Oriented Design* (2019), Chapter 2 ("Designing Classes with a Single Responsibility"), pp. 177-178.
